name: tagent_account_ip
label: Agent Account IP Table
description: The agent account IP table is used for related queries and report queries related to tagent.

fields.name: account_id
fields.description: Account ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.description: The IP address corresponding to the account, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
